From Achtung Baby · Price: only you and what you touch; you can't attack and stay @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}.

Theme Space

  • 1: 2 actions: you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} until you attack or for 1 minute. Concentrate.
  • 5: One creature you touch also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible}.
  • 9: Surge: invisibility no longer ends when you attack, for 1 round.
  • 13: Up to three touched creatures.
  • 17: Invisibility lasts 10 minutes.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
